notes: Access route: direct HTTPS fetch works fine for HTML shells (no WAF/Cloudflare block on www.jaypore.com itself for plain requests or curl_cffi); site is Next.js App Router with the full mega-menu (all categories, categoryid, linkRewrite, siteLinkRewrite) inlined as escaped JSON in the homepage RSC payload -- taxonomy below was extracted verbatim from that JSON (https://www.jaypore.com/, l0=1298 = the HOME top-nav), not guessed. Count verification: exhaustively attempted (see per-row flag) -- product grid + counts are fetched client-side via an authenticated internal PLP API (apigateway.jaypore.com/plp/fetchProducts, POST, requires MD5-hashed device-registration handshake) that could not be reproduced without browser automation (disallowed for this pool); every qty is null+flagged rather than estimated. Scope/exclusions applied: HOME mega-menu groups BED LINEN, TABLE LINEN, FLOOR COVERING (cushion covers, bedsheets, towels, bedcovers, quilts, throws, curtains, dohars, pillow covers, cushions, blankets, bed sets, mats, table runner/cloth/napkins/linen sets, rugs, dhurries) dropped entirely as textiles/furniture. Within KITCHEN & DINING: Cutlery and Utility & Storage dropped (kitchen tools / plain storage -- meta description confirms 'functional storage'). Within DRINKWARE & BAR: Bar Tools dropped (explicit exclusion). Within DECOR: Basket dropped -- checked its meta description directly ('Perfect for storage with a touch of traditional elegance') and it is a storage basket, not decor. Within LIGHTING: Candles dropped -- meta description confirms 'beautifully scented candles' = Home Fragrance, explicitly excluded (Diyas/Tea Light Holders/Diyas & candle stands kept as they are unscented decorative candle holders). WALLPAPER and GIFT SETS groups dropped entirely (explicit exclusions). FURNITURE group (nav bundles Tables+Mirror together) -- kept Mirror only via an isolated single-facet URL, dropped Tables (Rule 0: mirrors always in scope regardless of the site's own grouping). OUTDOOR group (Garden Accessory+Planter+Pots) -- kept Planter only via an isolated single-facet URL, dropped Garden Accessory/Pots (garden/plant-pot functional items). ART group kept in full (Decorative Folk Art / Contemporary Art / Textile Art -- all read as decorative wall-art mediums, not apparel textiles). Duplicate-company determination: no other Aditya Birla Fashion / ABFRL brand has been processed in this batch under a name that would collide with Jaypore (its commons.js/S3 asset prefix is brand-scoped 'prod/Jaypore/', confirming it is a standalone catalogue, not a mirror of another already-extracted company).

rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: category listing (products) is rendered entirely client-side after JS hydration (Next.js App Router). Server HTML/SSR only contains the page shell + nav menu JSON (no product grid, no count, no JSON-LD ItemList/numberOfItems -- only a BreadcrumbList schema). The real product grid is fetched client-side via POST apigateway.jaypore.com/plp/fetchProducts (confirmed by reverse-engineering commons.js), which requires a signed device-registration handshake (POST device/register with an MD5 hash over a client-fingerprint payload, then Authorization: Bearer <token> + securekey header on every call) that cannot be reliably reproduced without executing the site's JS (browser automation disallowed for this pool). Tried: plain fetch, curl_cffi impersonation (chrome124/chrome120/safari17_0/edge101) -- identical shell HTML every time; r.jina.ai -- blocked by a Cloudflare interstitial on the origin before rendering; GET apigateway.jaypore.com/category/getCategoryInfo?linkrewrite=... responds 200 from a live Elasticsearch cluster but returns 0 hits for every slug tried (including generic ones like 'kurtas'), consistent with it needing the same auth handshake. No exact count obtainable via any permitted route; qty left null with this flag on every row.
